enable_wishlist.label: Enable wishlist
enable_wishlist.description: If Addonify WooCommerce Wishlist plugin is disabled, its functionality will not work.

wishlist_page.label: Wishlist page
wishlist_page.description: Choose the page where you would like the wishlist table to be displayed.

require_login.label: Login required
require_login.description: Set if a user is required to be logged in to add product into the wishlist.

if_not_login_action.label: Action on add to wishlist button for guest user
if_not_login_action.description: If user login is required, choose what action to take next when a guest user clicks on add to wishlist button.

after_add_to_wishlist_action.label: Action after added to wishlist
after_add_to_wishlist_action.description: After a product has been successfully added to the wishlist, choose what action to take next.

remove_from_wishlist_if_added_to_cart.label: Remove product from wishlist after added to cart
remove_from_wishlist_if_added_to_cart.description: Remove product from wishlist if the product is added to cart.

enable_wishlist_on_myaccount_page.label: Enable wishlist tab on My account page
enable_wishlist_on_myaccount_page.description: Adds Wishlist tab and wishlist page link in my account page.

custom_css.label: Custom CSS
custom_css.description: If required, add your custom CSS code here.

view_wishlist_btn_text.label: View wishlist link button label
view_wishlist_btn_text.description: Set the label to the button that links to the wishlist page within the popup modal.

product_added_to_wishlist_text.label: Product added to wishlist text
product_added_to_wishlist_text.description: Set the text to be displayed when a product added to wishlist. Use, placeholder {product_name} to display name of the product.

product_already_in_wishlist_text.label: Product already in wishlist text
product_already_in_wishlist_text.description: Set the text to be displayed when a product that is already in the wishlist is attempted to be added again. Use, placeholder {product_name} to display name of the product.

product_removed_from_wishlist_text.label: Product removed from wishlist text
product_removed_from_wishlist_text.description: Set the text to be displayed when a product that is removed from the wishlist. Use, placeholder {product_name} to display name of the product.

success_emptying_wishlist_message.label: Wishlist emptied text
success_emptying_wishlist_message.description: Set the text to be displayed when the wishlist is successfully emptied.

could_not_add_to_wishlist_error_descript.label: Product could not be added to wishlist text
could_not_add_to_wishlist_error_descript.description: Set the error message to be displayed when a product could not be added into the wishlist. Use, placeholder {product_name} to display name of the product.
could_not_add_to_wishlist_error_descript.value: Something went wrong. <br>{product_name} was not added to wishlist. Please refresh page and try again.

could_not_remove_from_wishlist_error_des.label: Product could not be removed from wishlist text
could_not_remove_from_wishlist_error_des.description: Set the error message to be displayed when a product could not be removed from the wishlist. Use, placeholder {product_name} to display name of the product.
could_not_remove_from_wishlist_error_des.value: Something went wrong. <br>{product_name} was not removed wishlist. Please refresh page and try again.

security_token_error_message.label: Security token error message
security_token_error_message.description: Set the error message to be displayed when the security token is invalid.

invalid_product_id_error_message.label: Invalid Product id error message
invalid_product_id_error_message.description: Set the error message to be displayed when the product id is invalid.

invalid_product_error_message.label: Invalid product error message
invalid_product_error_message.description: Set the error message to be displayed when the product is invalid.

product_not_in_wishlist_error_message.label: Product not in wishlist error message
product_not_in_wishlist_error_message.description: Set the error message to be displayed when the product does not exit in the wishlist.
product_not_in_wishlist_error_message.value: {product_name} does not exist in the wishlist.

error_emptying_wishlist_message.label: Wishlist could not be emptied error message
error_emptying_wishlist_message.description: Set the error message to be displayed when the wishlist could not be emptied.

login_required_message.label: Login required text
login_required_message.description: Set the text to be displayed when user login is required.
login_required_message.value: Please login before adding item to Wishlist

login_btn_label.label: Login link button label
login_btn_label.description: Set the label for button that links to login page.

confirmation_message_for_emptying_wishli.label: Confirmation text message for emptying wishlist
confirmation_message_for_emptying_wishli.description: Set the text to be displayed when user tries to empty the wishlist.
confirmation_message_for_emptying_wishli.value: Do you want to empty the wishlist?

popup_close_btn_icon_color_on_hover.label: On hover close button icon color

popup_modal_btn_text_color_hover.label: On hover label color for buttons

popup_modal_btn_bg_color_hover.label: On hover background color for buttons

btn_position.label: Add to Wishlist button position on product loop
btn_position.description: Choose where in the product loop of the product catalog you would like the "Add to Wishlist" button to be displayed.

btn_position_on_single.label: Add to Wishlist button position on product single
btn_position_on_single.description: Choose where in the add to cart form of product singble you would like the "Add to Wishlist" button to be displayed.

remove_already_added_product_from_wishli.label: Remove product from the wishlist on double click
remove_already_added_product_from_wishli.description: Enable the option to remove a product from the wishlist on double click on "Added to Wishlist" or "Already in Wishlist" buttons.

btn_custom_class.label: Custom CSS class
btn_custom_class.description: Add custom CSS class or classes to "Add to Wishlist" button. If more than one CSS classes are to be added, separate CSS classes with a space.

enable_save_for_later.label: Enable save for later button
enable_save_for_later.description: Enable the option to display the "Save for Later" button for products on the cart page.

save_for_later_btn_label.label: Button label
save_for_later_btn_label.description: Set the label for "Save for Later" button.

save_for_later_btn_label_after_added_to_.label: Button label after added to wishlist
save_for_later_btn_label_after_added_to_.description: Set the label for "Save for Later" button after the product is added to wishlist.

save_for_later_btn_position.label: Button position
save_for_later_btn_position.description: Choose where you want the "Save for Later" button to be displayed on the cart page.

btn_label.label: Add to Wishlist Button label
btn_label.description: Set the label for "Add to Wishlist" button.

btn_label_when_added_to_wishlist.label: Added to Wishlist Button Label
btn_label_when_added_to_wishlist.description: Set the label for "Added to Wishlist" button.

btn_label_if_added_to_wishlist.label: Already in Wishlist Button Label
btn_label_if_added_to_wishlist.description: Set the label for "Already in Wishlist" button.

show_icon.label: Display icon in button
show_icon.description: Enable the option to display icon on the "Add to Wishlist" button.

icon_position.label: Button Icon Position
icon_position.description: Choose where to display the icon on the "Add to Wishlist" button.

empty_wishlist_label.label: Text when the wishlist is empty
empty_wishlist_label.description: Set the text when there are no products in the wishlist.

show_empty_wishlist_navigation_link.label: Display a link
show_empty_wishlist_navigation_link.description: Enable this option to display a link to the selected page when the wishlist is empty.

empty_wishlist_navigation_link.label: Page to be linked
empty_wishlist_navigation_link.description: Choose the page to be linked in the text when the wishlist is empty.

clear_wishlist_label.label: Button label
clear_wishlist_label.description: Set the label of the button to empty the wishlist.

show_sidebar.label: Display sidebar
show_sidebar.description: Enable this option to display the sidebar where the wishlist is displayed.

sidebar_position.label: Sidebar position
sidebar_position.description: Choose the position where the sidebar should be displayed.

sidebar_title.label: Sidebar title
sidebar_title.description: Set the title of the wishlist that is displayed inside the sidebar.

view_wishlist_page_button_label.label: Wishlist page button link label
view_wishlist_page_button_label.description: Set the label for the button that links to the wishlist page.

sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_label_co.label: Wishlist page button link label color
sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_label_co.description: Set the color for label for the button that links to the wishlist page.

sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_label_co.label: Wishlist page button link label color on hover
sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_label_co.description: Set the color for label on hover for the button that links to the wishlist page.

sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_bg_color.label: Wishlist page button link background color
sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_bg_color.description: Set the color for label for the button that links to the wishlist page.

sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_bg_color.label: Wishlist page button link background color on hover
sidebar_modal_view_wishlist_btn_bg_color.description: Set the color for label on hover for the button that links to the wishlist page.

sidebar_empty_wishlist_label.label: Empty wishlist text
sidebar_empty_wishlist_label.description: Set the text to be displayed when there are no products in the wishlist.

sidebar_btn_label.label: Button label
sidebar_btn_label.description: Set the label for the sidebar toggle button.

sidebar_btn_position_offset.label: Button position offset
sidebar_btn_position_offset.description: Set left and right position offset to the sidebar toggle button. The value is in px

sidebar_show_icon.label: Display button icon
sidebar_show_icon.description: Enable this option to display an icon on the sidebar toggle button.

sidebar_toggle_btn_icon.label: Button icon
sidebar_toggle_btn_icon.description: Choose the icon to be displayed on the sidebar toggle button.
